construction_revision.reason: Explicitly rebind the existing historical-context consumer after the appended evidence-policy event; source values are unchanged and do not establish the revised predicate.

selection_limitation: Post hoc favorable-series selection requested for balance, not a preregistered effect test or representative assessment of all access conditions. Worsening and unchanged evidence remains in the full primary-care measurement.
counting_rule: Three distinct original measures, no complements counted as additional observations. GP measures concern overlapping people and are not independent agency gains; no composite score or sum.

signals.measurement_status_meaning: Published observations reproduced from retained primary-source bytes; actor control and personal agency remain unverified.

metric.denominator: Patients with Medicare GP non-referred attendances in the year
metric.population: Patients with Medicare GP non-referred attendances in the year
metric.aggregation: Published state-level patient-year administrative share or survey-weighted estimate; difference is percentage points, not percentage change.
metric.evaluation_rule: Compare retained NSW 2024-25 estimate with 2023-24 using the original denominator. Favorable direction alone is not a causal effect or a statistically tested difference.

signals.uncertainty: Administrative patient-year share; no sampling interval supplied in selected table. Claims coverage and service-definition limitations remain.
signals.condition_lowered: A larger share of attending patients had no out-of-pocket charge for all their Medicare GP attendances during the year. This narrows an observed price exposure, not every cost of care.
signals.for_whom: Patients with Medicare GP non-referred attendances in the year
signals.owner: General practices set fees and bulk-billing choices; Australian Government sets Medicare benefits
signals.evidence_ceiling: Patient-year fully bulk-billed share, not share of services or clinics, and excludes people with no claimed attendance.
